fig_design_and_split_schematic: Model and evaluation design. (a) A 230-letter one-hot input (a 200-letter piece between two 15-letter adapters) passes through the published MPRA-LegNet convolutional body, shared by eight outputs: three lentiMPRA cell types and five plasmid-MPRA cell types. The loss is a masked mean squared error, so each row trains only the outputs it was measured in. Model 2 adds self-distillation from the average of three untaught seed models. (b) The natural-variant table was split by chromosome before training. All choices were made on the practice chromosomes, and the pass marks were confirmed before the locked chromosomes were written to disk and scored once.
fig_locked_test_effect_pearson: Blind locked-test results on chromosomes 5, 14 and 22. Filled circles show the mean over HepG2 and K562 of the Pearson correlation between predicted and measured allelic skew on active variants, with 95% block-bootstrap intervals; open triangles and squares show HepG2 and K562 separately. Model 2 is far ahead of model 1, the published MPRA-LegNet and a 6-mer ridge baseline. It is slightly behind MPAC (difference -0.010, 95% interval -0.019 to -0.001), which averages 10 networks of about 4.1M parameters for each chromosome and was run with one centred window.
fig_ensemble_gap_decomposition: Where the gap to MPAC comes from, on practice chromosomes 6, 13 and 20 (no training). A single MPAC network (0.578 to 0.588, mean 0.583) is about as accurate as model 2 (0.584). Averaging MPAC networks, whose predictions agree less with each other (mean pairwise Pearson 0.908), raises accuracy to 0.609. Averaging up to 10 of our own models, whose seeds agree more (0.958), reaches only 0.589, and adding model 2 to MPAC gives 0.608.
fig_practice_screen_changes: One-change screens on practice chromosomes 6, 13 and 20, each against model 2 without self-distillation (black line, 0.573); the dashed line marks the 10-network MPAC average (0.609). Circles and diamonds show the two seeds where two were run. Only self-distillation and a 3 times wider body (4.0M parameters) gave small gains. The Malinois design was undertrained under our 25-epoch recipe.
